long_description.before:
Artisan is the GTM orchestration platform. We build AI employees, called Artisans, that run your entire go-to-market on one system, so you can replace the 5-8 tool stack most revenue teams stitch together at $100K+ a year.

Three Artisans, each owning a whole job:

Ava, the AI BDR, runs outbound end to end. She finds best-fit leads across 400M+ contacts (270M+ B2B, 130M+ local businesses), researches each one, writes and sends personalized email and social outreach, runs dialer call steps, handles every reply and books meetings on the right rep's calendar. Over 90% of our customers run her fully autonomously.

Aaron, the inbound SDR, lives on your website. He identifies visitors, qualifies them against your ICP, answers from your knowledge base, books meetings with CRM-owner routing and enrolls anyone who doesn't book into Ava's outreach.

Aria, the AI AE, runs live, personalized product demos grounded in your knowledge base, handles objections in real time and drives the next step: start a trial or book your human AE.

Underneath them is the whole stack, consolidated: prospecting data with waterfall enrichment across a dozen providers (replaces ZoomInfo, Apollo, Cognism), list building and intent signals (Clay, Common Room), sequencing for centrally managed and rep-led campaigns (Outreach, Salesloft), parallel dialing (Nooks, Orum), website visitor identification and inbound chat (Qualified). One shared knowledge base powers every Artisan. Usage-based credits, no seats, no platform fee.

Built for enterprise: SOC 2 Type II, GDPR and CCPA compliant, SSO/SAML, role-based access and a full audit trail. Native Salesforce and HubSpot sync with owner mapping, do-not-contact enforcement and field-level controls. The common pattern is sales ops running Ava centrally for a thousand-plus AEs who only log in for escalations.

YC W24. $35M+ raised from investors including Y Combinator and HubSpot Ventures. Customers include SaaStr, SumUp, CookUnity, Superhuman and Higgsfield. Raise sourced over $700K of ARR in six months with Ava. SumUp generates leads at $52 each. Teams in San Francisco and New York. We're hiring.
long_description.after:
Artisan builds AI employees, called Artisans, that take on real work and help teams accomplish more. Our mission is to build AI employees that can take responsibility for work across a broad range of roles and industries.

Our first three Artisans focus on sales:

Ava is our outbound AI BDR. She finds and researches prospects, runs personalized outreach, handles replies, and books meetings.

Aaron is our inbound AI SDR. He engages website visitors, answers questions, qualifies leads, and books meetings with the right person.

Aria is our AI account executive. She delivers personalized product demos, handles objections, and helps prospects take the next step.

These first three employees are the starting point for a much broader AI employee company. We're building toward a future in which businesses can delegate meaningful work to AI employees across their organizations, with people setting direction and collaborating where their judgment matters.

We're a small team with offices in San Francisco and New York. We value technical ambition, fast iteration, and taking responsibility for results. We're hiring people who want to help build the next generation of AI employees.

one_liner.before: The GTM orchestration platform. Ava, Aaron and Aria replace your stack
one_liner.after: AI employees that take on real work, starting with sales

long_description.before: ReasonBlocks is the runtime layer that makes AI agents cheaper and more reliable. We correct agent reasoning and compress tokens mid-run, with gains compounding across runs. On SWE-Bench pro we have seen a 52% token reduction and 42% accuracy lift.
